store.summary: Minimal native Rust 3D FPV tinywhoop simulator with USB-C & BT controller support.
store.description: StickZero is a lightweight, zero-dependency 3D FPV quadcopter simulator written in pure Rust for the M5Stack CardputerZero. Inspired by StickTime-Pi, it renders directly to the 320x170 ST7789v3 RGB565 display at 60 FPS with 240 Hz 6-DOF quaternion physics. Features BetaFPV Air75 II (75mm) and Meteor75 Pro II (1S 75mm) presets, Lava II 580mAh/680mAh battery weight & sag physics, custom Betaflight Actual rates, stock prop wash, toggleable NTSC/RF Analog FX, real-time synthesized tinywhoop audio, 4 tracks (Meadow Loop, Figure 8, Dive Tower, Bando), and a 4-step USB-C/Bluetooth controller calibration wizard.
